# Key findings (generated by notebooks/eda.py)

- Data: 7,305 hourly rows, 27 Aug 2026 to 26 Oct 2026.
- Most polluted area on average: **Hinjewadi** (26.7 ug/m3). Cleanest: **Pimpri-Chinchwad** (23.8 ug/m3).
- Worst hour of the day: **23:00** (30.6 ug/m3). Best hour: **15:00** (18.9 ug/m3).
- Weekends vs weekdays: PM2.5 is -1.6% on weekends.
- Correlation of PM2.5 with wind speed: -0.58; with humidity: -0.21.
- 0.1% of all hours were above 90 ug/m3 (CPCB 'Poor' or worse).
